questions.name: moneta_memory
questions.note: W2: the four moneta_runtime.py conditions, observed live. pluginpath_set + pluginfo_on_disk = env reached the process; plugin_registered = Plug registry sees the codeless plugin; type_registered/is_concrete = SchemaRegistry resolves MonetaMemory; roundtrip_typed = a typed prim survives author->save->fresh-reopen with IsA(Usd.Typed) and a populated definition. All four true = the deployed package env is doing its job and MonetaBackedStore's use_real_usd=True init has what it needs.
